tactics:
induction m with
  | zero => intro f init; rfl
  | succ m ih => intro f init; simp [Nat.fold_succ, ih]

induction m with
  | zero => intro f init; simp [Nat.fold_zero]
  | succ m ih => intro f init; rw [Nat.fold_succ, Nat.fold_succ, ih]
induction m <;> intro f init <;> simp_all [Nat.fold_succ, Nat.fold_zero]
induction m <;> intro f init <;> grind [Nat.fold_succ, Nat.fold_zero]
